name: application-treemap
title: Treemap
description: Nested proportional rectangles sized by value for visualizing hierarchical breakdowns like storage usage or revenue by segment.
useWhen: Nested proportional rectangles sized by value for visualizing hierarchical breakdowns like storage usage or revenue by segment.
avoidWhen: Avoid treemap when a simpler pattern communicates the same content or action.
responsiveBehavior: Treemap uses responsive Tailwind utilities where present. Test its layout and interaction states at mobile, tablet, and desktop widths before shipping.
accessibility: Keep semantic HTML structure and visible text labels when adapting this component.
Preserve the component’s semantic HTML when adapting its visual treatment.
Do not use color, iconography, or position as the only way to communicate meaning or state.
